Name: Kaijou Jurrider
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
Named for the mounts they use, the jurriders are (usually) dinosaur tamers who form strong bonds with their wild mounts. They intuitively coordinate and direct them, adding their own proficiency and tactical skills to their companion. When a jurrider or their mount is critically injured the other flies into an emotional outburst, striking wildly at whoever hurt their partner.

Though these warriors usually ride dinosaurs, they are known to break any mount.

***Riding Skill.*** The jurrider has proficiency in Wisdom (Riding) checks, and as a result can add their proficiency bonus to their mount’s attacks, saves, and checks instead of the mount’s proficiency bonus, as long as the mount’s is lower. They can also use their reaction to add their proficiency bonus to any roll their mount makes that does not benefit from either of their proficiency bonuses.

traits.name: Companion Critical
traits.description: The kaijou’s mount scores a critical hit on the same d20 results the kaijou would (19 or 20). The mount retains this benefit while raging as per the kaijou’s Vengeful Loyalty.

traits.name: Fearless
traits.description: The kaijou has advantage on saving throws against being frightened. Even when frightened, no effect can force them to flee from the source of their fear unless they would do so for other purposes.

traits.name: Quick Mount
traits.description: The kaijou can mount or dismount a loyal creature without spending extra movement, simply moving into or out of their space as part of their regular movement.

traits.name: Vengeful Loyalty
traits.description: If the kaijou or its mount is reduced to 0 hit points or killed, the other flies into a rage for 1 minute. During this time, the raging creature has advantage on attack rolls and Strength and Dexterity saving throws, but attack rolls made against them have advantage as well. This rage ends if the injured creature regains consciousness.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The kaijou makes two poison shortspear attacks. It carries eight of these shortspears.

actions.name: Flintash Shortspear
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target or thrown as a Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) fire damage.

actions.name: Companion Command
actions.description: The kaijou commands its mount to take any action it is capable of (except its Multiattack, if it has one), including using the kaijou’s own bonus action to allow the mount to use its own.

reactions.name: Stay Steady
reactions.description: When the kaijou would be knocked prone or knocked from their mount, they can remain mounted or standing instead. If they would be moved against their will from their mount to a degree it would dismount them, they are only moved as far as possible while staying mounted.
